subject: Editorial launch story — hero, rhythm, and proof in one scroll
preheader: See how we structured this campaign: a bold hero, a magazine-style image and copy row, an inset text card, social proof, dividers for breathing room, and a framed CTA—open for the full Visual Architect layout.

content.headline: Ship the story, not the slide deck
content.subheadline: One narrative arc from first impression to proof—built with VA2 sections you can still edit freely in Unlayer.
content.imagePrompt: [STOCK] Editorial workspace with large monitor, soft window light, minimal desk, plants, calm professional atmosphere, wide negative space for headline overlay, no readable text in scene
content.altText: Calm editorial workspace with natural light

content.headline: Why rhythm beats density
content.body: Readers skim in F-patterns. Alternate imagery and copy, add dividers between ideas, and let testimonials sit on their own row so proof does not compete with the pitch.
content.imagePrompt: [STOCK] Magazine spread on a wooden table, coffee cup, soft morning light, editorial photography, shallow depth of field
content.altText: Magazine spread and coffee on a table

content.body: Use inset cards for long explanations so the eye gets a clear boundary. Pair with a band or flush section variant when you want full-bleed strips or flat copy.

content.quote: The template finally looks like our brand—not a blank stack of blocks. The framed CTA and testimonial sold our exec team.
